arxiv-2110-10794.title: Low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computing using long-range connectivity
arxiv-2110-10794.creator: Lawrence Z. Cohen, Isaac H. Kim, Stephen D. Bartlett, Benjamin J. Brown
arxiv-2110-10794.description: Abstract Vast numbers of qubits will be needed for large-scale quantum computing due to the overheads associated with error correction. We present a scheme for low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computation based on quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, where long-range interactions enable many logical qubits to be encoded with a modest number of physical qubits.

arxiv-2203-14850.title: A Fly in the Ointment: An Empirical Study on the Characteristics of Ethereum Smart Contracts Code Weaknesses and Vulnerabilities
arxiv-2203-14850.creator: Majd Soud, Grischa Liebel, Mohammad Hamdaqa
arxiv-2203-14850.description: Abstract Context: Smart contracts are computer programs that are automatically executed on the blockchain. Among other issues, vulnerabilities in their implementation have led to severe loss and theft of cryptocurrency. In contrast to traditional software, smart contracts become immutable when deployed to the Ethereum blockchain.

arxiv-2207-09690.title: Design of Coded Caching Schemes with Linear Subpacketizations Based on Injective Arc Coloring of Regular Digraphs
arxiv-2207-09690.creator: Xianzhang Wu, Minquan Cheng, Li Chen, Senior Member, IEEE, Congduan Li, Member, IEEE, Zifan Shi
arxiv-2207-09690.description: Abstract Coded caching is an effective technique to decongest the amount of traffic in the backhaul link. In such a scheme, each file hosted in the server is divided into a number of packets to pursue a low transmission rate based on the delicate design of contents cached into users and broadcast messages.

arxiv-2211-15694.title: Relaxion Dark Matter from Stochastic Misalignment
arxiv-2211-15694.creator: and Géraldine Servant
arxiv-2211-15694.description: Abstract Cosmological relaxation of the electroweak scale via Higgs-axion interplay, named as relaxion mechanism, provides a dynamical solution to the Higgs mass hierarchy. In the original proposal by Graham, Kaplan and Rajendran, the relaxion abundance today is too small to explain the dark matter of the universe because of the high suppression of the misalignment angle after inflation.

arxiv-2301-12983.title: Metric SYZ conjecture for certain toric Fano hypersurfaces
arxiv-2301-12983.creator: Yang Li
arxiv-2301-12983.description: Abstract We prove the metric version of the SYZ conjecture for a class of Calabi-Yau hypersurfaces inside toric Fano manifolds, by solving a variational problem whose minimizer may be interpreted as a global solution of the real Monge-Ampère equation on certain polytopes. This does not rely on discrete symmetry.

arxiv-2306-01834.title: Spectral analogues of Barbarian asteroids among CO and CV chondrites
arxiv-2306-01834.creator: Max Mahlke, Jolantha Eschrig, Benoit Carry, Lydie Bonal, Pierre Beck
arxiv-2306-01834.description: Abstract K- and L-type asteroids are considered to be the parent bodies of CV and CO chondrites. Spectral models of L-types invoke an enrichment in CAI with respect to the chondrites in the meteorite collection. Barbarian asteroids are associated to L-type asteroids yet the relationship between these populations is still not clear.

arxiv-2405-01553.title: Empirical Studies of Parameter Efficient Methods for Large Language Models of Code and Knowledge Transfer to R Thanks: This research is supported by a grant from Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada RGPIN-2019-05175 and Mitacs Accelerate award, 2024.
arxiv-2405-01553.creator: Amirreza Esmaeili, Iman Saberi, Fatemeh Fard
arxiv-2405-01553.description: Abstract Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods are proposed as an alternative fine-tuning approach for Large Language Models (LLM) to minimize high training costs. While prior research demonstrates the effectiveness of PEFT methods in knowledge transfer using smaller language models, their application to larger LLMs, particularly in low-resource and unseen programming languages such as R, remains under-explored.

arxiv-2410-17538.title: Primal-Dual Spectral Representation for Off-policy Evaluation
arxiv-2410-17538.creator: Yang Hu ∗, Tianyi Chen, Na Li, Kai Wang, Bo Dai
arxiv-2410-17538.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yang Hu ∗, Tianyi Chen, Na Li, Kai Wang, Bo Dai. Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is one of the most fundamental problems in reinforcement learning (RL) to estimate the expected long-term payoff of a given target policy with only experiences from another behavior policy that is potentially unknown. The distribution correction estimation (DICE) family of estimators have advanced the state of the art in OPE by breaking the curse of horizon .

arxiv-2503-16648.title: High-quality Peccei-Quinn symmetry from the
arxiv-2503-16648.description: Abstract We explore a class of axion models where an accidental U ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathrm{U}(1) Peccei-Quinn (PQ) symmetry automatically emerges from the interplay of vertical (grand-unified) and horizontal (flavor) gauge symmetries. Focusing on a specific Pati-Salam realization, we analyze the quality of the PQ symmetry and demonstrate that the model non-trivially reproduces the Standard Model flavor structure.

pmc-12599660.title: Association between serum uric acid to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio and female infertility in women aged 18 to 45 years: A study based on NHANES 2013 to 2018
pmc-12599660.creator: Heng Zhang
pmc-12599660.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The uric acid (UA) to HDL-cholesterol ratio (UHR) has recently been proposed as a novel marker of cardiometabolic and inflammatory risk. This study aimed to investigate the association between UHR and infertility in U.S. women of reproductive age. We analyzed data from 2447 women aged 18 to 45 years in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2013 to 2018 cycles.

pmc-12721724.title: Hypophysitis in a HIV‐Positive Patient With a Syphilis Latent Infection
pmc-12721724.creator: Fernando Sotelo-Díaz, Astrid Paola Hernández-Valdez, Ismael Quintal-Medina, Jesús Cajigas-Silva, Sarbelio Moreno-Espinosa, Luis Esteban Ramírez-González, José Guillermo Flores-Vázquez, Lesly Portocarrero-Ortíz
pmc-12721724.description: BackgroundHypophysitis is a rare inflammatory disorder of the pituitary gland that may result from primary autoimmune disease or secondary causes such as infection. In people living with HIV, coinfection with Treponema pallidum can precipitate pituitary inflammation, leading to panhypopituitarism, visual field compromise, and neurological symptoms.

pmc-12735567.title: The Effects of Non-Guided Versus Guided Podcast Production on Perception of English Reading Skills in Undergraduate Nursing Students: A Quasi-Experimental Study
pmc-12735567.creator: Sirinthip Phuwayanon, Nethong Namprom, Patcharee Woragidpoonpol, Suwimol Daroonratsamee, Daniel Thomas Bressington
pmc-12735567.description: Background: Nurses need strong English language skills to access knowledge and promote evidence-based practice. Podcast production is a promising pedagogical strategy to improve language skills. However, the effects of podcast production on nursing students’ perceived English reading proficiency and the most effective production instructional approaches remain unreported.

pmc-13237800.title: Blood transcriptomic signatures distinguish Mycobacterium avium complex pulmonary disease from colonization: a multicenter cohort study
pmc-13237800.creator: Wen-Yuan Lin, Hung-Ling Huang, Chia-Ni Hsiung, Ya-Yun Huang, Meng-Rui Lee, Meng-Hsuan Cheng, Inn-Wen Chong, Jann-Yuan Wang
pmc-13237800.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pulmonary infections caused by nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM), particularly Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC), are increasingly recognized as an important clinical entity, yet distinguishing active pulmonary disease from asymptomatic colonization remains challenging because current diagnosis relies on composite criteria. In this study, we aimed to identify blood transcriptomic signatures that discriminate MAC pulmonary disease (MAC-PD) from pulmonary colonization (MAC-PC) and to evaluate their potential as candidate biomarkers.

pmc-13579667.creator: Irene A. Kindole, Humphrey G. Medarakini, Alphonce N. Simbila, Christine A Kindole, Peter P Kunambi, Evelyne G. Mapunda, Said S. Kilindimo, Ellen J. Weber

pmc-13668299.title: Clinical and patient-reported predictors of days alive and out of hospital in decompensated cirrhosis
pmc-13668299.creator: Sai Kiran Kuchana, Eric S. Orman, Kelly Mosesso, Timothy Stump, Patrick O. Monahan, Naga Chalasani, Archita P. Desai
pmc-13668299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Days alive and out of hospital (DAOH) is a patient-centered outcome, but has not been studied in decompensated cirrhosis (DCC). We aimed to quantify DAOH and to identify clinical and patient-reported factors associated with DAOH.Methods:Using an ongoing prospective cohort study of adults hospitalized with DCC, DAOH was calculated by subtracting days hospitalized, transplanted, or deceased from 90 days post-discharge from index hospitalization.
